input_protocol.format: 76 whitespace-separated fields per processed frame; float fields round-trip f32; no frame decimation

events.0: apply receiving parameters, preserve runtime, then process
events.1: fresh instance with receiving parameters, then process
events.2: apply receiving parameters, runtime Initialize without changing parameters, then process

input_protocol.port_fields: channel count followed by all sixteen raw values; inactive slots are positive zero in every reference frame
input_protocol.last_field: consumer_mask: bit0 sine, bit1 triangle, bit2 saw, bit3 square
input_protocol.parameter_changes: SDK assigns actual params in place; production probe rebuilds with receiving params and adopts previous runtime. No comparison adapter may duplicate oscillator arithmetic.
input_protocol.consumer_adapter: On each output connection transition only, SDK adapter assigns channels=1 when connecting and channels=0 when disconnecting. The actual LFO then controls connected output widths via setChannels; it does not process disconnected waveform writes. Production reports zero channels for disconnected outputs.

order: four output-major arrays of sixteen voltages
scalar clock-trigger state: LOW=0 HIGH=1 UNINITIALIZED=2
output_protocol.initial_snapshot: Before the first process of every fresh case independently assert phases=0, reset-high=true, scalar clock-trigger=UNINITIALIZED, clock_frequency=1, clock_timer=0, divider=0 and five lights=0. Initial connected output counts depend on the adapter, so are not an oscillator initial-state assertion.

numeric_gate.sine_rationale: Predeclared engineering error budget for SDK SSE Cephes sine versus production f32 sine. Identical phase state and f32 angle construction are required. Phase keeps the sine argument within [-pi/2,2*pi); argument reduction is small. The 3 microvolt budget allows several f32 rounding units across the unit sine and 5 V scale/offset arithmetic. This is a qualification threshold, not a proved libm/SDK error guarantee; a failure must be reported, never fitted away.
numeric_gate.exact: Every frame: all four output counts; every connected active triangle, saw and square sample in exact f32 bits including signed zero; all sixteen phases, all sixteen reset states, scalar clock state, clock frequency, timer, divider and five light values in exact bits/integer equality. Sine samples must be finite and within the predeclared absolute budget with no alignment or warmup exclusion.
numeric_gate.independent_checks: Each implementation independently: output count is max(1,FM width) when connected and zero when disconnected; phases finite in [0,1); output values finite, within [-5,5] bipolar or [0,10] unipolar plus sine tolerance; explicit per-case anchors; divider follows frame index modulo16 despite Initialize; lights unchanged between divider updates; on divider updates invert/offset equal current params, poly phase RGB equals [0,0,1], mono R=G and B=0. Fresh snapshot assertions precede processing.
numeric_gate.excluded_storage: Only disconnected output voltages and inactive output voltage slots are outside numeric comparison; their channel counts and all internal phases/triggers/lights remain compared. No active sample, frame, reset/clock state, light update or difficult corner is excluded. SDK SIMD writes inactive quartet storage whereas host output frames zero-pad it.
numeric_gate.required_flags: No fast-math or floating-point contraction; retain actual compiler flags, target/FPU environment, SDK headers/library and probe binaries. Do not set sample_time independently of 1.f/sample_rate.

reference_domain.definition: Every processed SIMD lane has finite effective pitch p=f32(rate+f32(FM*fm_amount)); b=f32(p+127) is in [0,256). This includes biased integer exponents 0..255 in the actual SIMD exp2Floor: zero and positive infinity are intentional endpoint cases. Raw inactive input slots are positive zero, including rounded-up SIMD lanes.
reference_domain.zero_exponent: For b in [0,1), exp2Floor yields zero, not mathematical subnormal exp2. This defined source corner is included, including p=-127 exactly.
reference_domain.high_corner: Biased exponent255 produces positive infinity, including effective pitch128, and finite exp2 can overflow when multiplied by accepted clock_frequency/2. Positive infinity is defined intermediate behavior and fmin(delta,0.5) caps phase advancement. Include both cases; do not exclude them.
reference_domain.safety_boundary: Negative biased exponents, wrapped exponent bits, out-of-range float-to-integer conversions, and nonfinite inputs are outside the frozen numerical domain. LFO uses SIMD intrinsic conversion/shift, not the scalar specialization's C++ signed shift; outside-domain behavior is not categorically called C++ undefined behavior. It can yield zero, negative or nonfinite approximations. Separate Rust-only safety rows require finite bounded output and state; they never execute the SDK oracle and never count as reference passes.

clock_reachability.timer_type: Rack dsp::Timer is TTimer<float>, adding f32 sample_time only while clock width is nonzero
clock_reachability.proof: At the listed power-of-two timer value, half an f32 ULP exceeds f32(1/rate), so round-to-nearest addition returns the same value. Monotonic nonnegative additions from zero cannot pass that fixed point. Thus any nonzero measured reciprocal is at least 1/512 or 1/256, strictly above .001 Hz. The slow-rejection branch is unreachable from fresh/Initialize state at these rates without private timer injection or a different time step.
clock_reachability.covered: High-at-start arming, low/high exact and adjacent thresholds, rejected >1000Hz intervals that still reset timer, accepted boundary-adjacent intervals, tempo changes, poly clock channel-zero-only behavior, missing pulses, disconnect timer/detector retention, reconnect, and runtime Initialize retaining trigger states and divider/lights.
clock_reachability.not_claimed: No injected timer state and no claim to have executed the unreachable <.001Hz rejection branch. A 65536-frame missing-pulse segment tests ordinary accumulated timer state at every frame.

fixture_plan.safety_gate: Rust only: all returned output counts follow consumer/width contract; every phase, timer, clock frequency, light and connected active output is finite; phases in [0,1), lights in [0,1], clock_frequency in [.001,1000] or source initial/default values; waveforms obey mode bounds. Safety behavior is not a numerical reference result.
fixture_plan.lifecycle_boundary: Direct exact production StockLfoProbe and actual class, same persistent instance per case. Parameter changes preserve runtime. Runtime Initialize is the actual module reset callback, not host UI reset-to-default parameters. Host graph adoption, bypass, telemetry transport, audio device behavior and rendering require separate tests.
